subject.title: [Feature Request] Add tool call visibility to streamTo="parent" for ACP runtime

question: Should ACP `streamTo="parent"` expose child tool calls, tool results, and thinking/progress internals to the parent session, and what default-hidden redaction or verbosity policy should govern that exposure?
rationale: The requested data can include secrets, file paths, command output, and reasoning-like content, and current code intentionally separates sanitized ACP diagnostics from raw session-update data.

options.title: Define redacted projection
options.body: Expose bounded summaries through existing ACP/channel visibility policy, with raw arguments, results, and thought hidden by default and covered by tests/docs.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Leave `streamTo="parent"` limited to assistant/commentary/status progress and direct detailed inspection to logs or richer session surfaces.

options.title: Add explicit raw verbose relay
options.body: Forward raw tool and thought data only behind an explicit opt-in, accepting a larger security and privacy review burden.

recommendation.title: Define redacted projection
recommendation.body: Expose bounded summaries through existing ACP/channel visibility policy, with raw arguments, results, and thought hidden by default and covered by tests/docs.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored and merged hardening on the same ACP parent commentary/progress relay and projection settings surface.
